title: Development and validation of convolutional neural network-based model to predict the risk of sentinel or non-sentinel lymph node metastasis in patients with breast cancer: a machine learning study.
summary: A CNN using learned MRI representations predicted pathology-referenced lymph-node metastasis in the retrospective cohort; second-stage sentinel-dissection input and hypothetical surgery decisions do not demonstrate clinical benefit.
ai_technology: A convolutional neural network learned MRI representations to predict sentinel and non-sentinel lymph-node metastasis, evaluated against retrospective nodal references.
